blocks.intro: A joint inside a finished skid is hard to re-inspect.

blocks.h: Questions quality and site teams ask

items.q: Can we audit the shop and see a joint log?
items.a: Yes. Visit the shop in Ontario, Canada by appointment, with reasonable notice. Audit our quality system on reasonable notice. Before you order, we show a specimen joint log; your own log is in your dossier.

items.q: What certificates come with the PP resin and pipe?
items.a: Each lot comes with the material certificates named in your proposal, showing conformity to the material standard it names. We check each polypropylene (PP) lot's marking against its certificate on receipt.

items.q: What happens to a rejected joint?
items.a: It is cut out and remade to our written repair procedure, under a new number. Rejection rate: reported on request.

items.q: How is a PP loop cleaned before first use?
items.a: We follow a written flush and cleaning procedure. The final rinse is Purified Water (PW), run to conductivity and total organic carbon (TOC) limits and recorded.
